entries.b7300aa7196550e1: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells instant bar-shaped ramen, sara udon, cup noodles and bag noodles. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,552 million. It manufactures instant bar-shaped ramen, sara udon and others at 3 plants, the Fukuoka Plant, Saga Plant and Kitahata Plant, and outsources the manufacture of cup noodles to Sanyo Foods Co., Ltd. and Acecook Co., Ltd., and of bag noodles to Sanyo Foods Co., Ltd. Sales are handled by 5 sales offices in Fukuoka, Hiroshima, Osaka, Nagoya and Tokyo, together with the Domestic Business Division and the Overseas Business Division, and products are sold through special agents (primary wholesalers) and wholesalers to mass retailers, convenience stores and others.
